release.description: Adds configurable error handling and enabled-tool filtering while improving Act inheritance, tool registration, and diagnostic logging.
release.action: Error Handling: Added configurable error handling for AI file processing and tool execution.
AI Providers: Added enabled-tool filtering for AI providers.
Act Processing: Fixed front matter inheritance across nested Act definitions.
Function Tools: Renamed tools and parameters to kebab-case and corrected the project directory parameter name.
Function Tools: Improved tool registration and provider tool-loading behavior.
Diagnostics: Improved diagnostic logging for function-tool loading.

release.description: Introduces a no-op GenAI provider, improves exception handling for serialized tool errors, resolves provider input logging, and optimizes usage tracking.
release.action: GenAI Providers: Added a no-op GenAI provider for scenarios that do not require an active model provider.
Error Handling: Added ErrorResultException support for serialized tool errors and provider-specific tool error results.
Error Handling: Fixed error handling during tool invocation and Anthropic tool error result processing.
AI Providers: Fixed provider input logging serialization and debug logging for AI providers.
Usage & Guidance: Fixed usage capture and prompt-instruction handling.
Diagnostics: Improved log output and removed obsolete logInputs handling.

release.description: Enhances Bindex tooling, configuration handling, and project automation capabilities while improving reliability across workflows.
release.action: Function Tooling: Introduced the ToolsProvider for managing functional tools and added support for singleton-loaded function tool instances.
Function Tooling: Added structured JSON-based process and act information handling.
Function Tooling: Added support for list and map parameter parsing, including generic map parameter handling.
Function Tooling: Implemented functional tool definitions using annotations, enabling seamless integration and discovery of tools.

Parameter Processing: Fixed file argument processing, prompt default values, non-parameterized Map parameters, generic Map conversion, object property type processing, input parameter application, and ordering of tool parameters.
Prompt Support: Added prompt publishing support with prompt bundles, prompt registration, and role metadata.
Prompt Support: Improved prompt template parameter default value processing and prompt registration behavior.
